description: Pay a BSV pay-per-call API (HTTP 402, BRC-166) from this kit's own BSV. Call with confirm false to see the price first.

body.description: Optional request body, sent unchanged on the price check and payment retry.

confirm.description: false previews the exact invoice price without signing; true signs and sends the BRC-166 payment header.

content_type.description: Optional Content-Type for body. Without it, a body is sent as application/json.

max_sats.description: Maximum invoice amount in satoshis. The kit refuses a higher price and its own caps may be lower.

method.description: Optional HTTP method. Defaults to GET.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the BSV pay-per-call API resource.

name: pay_402
title: Pay BSV HTTP 402 API
